# megapot.build — file manifest

app/layout.tsx — factory document shell + builder title/meta
app/page.tsx — factory landing
app/disclaimer/page.tsx — independence + 18+ note
app/robots.ts — allow pages; disallow /go (302 only)
app/sitemap.ts — / and /disclaimer/ only
src/components/FactoryLanding.tsx — two-step launch factory; clones ship a player site
src/components/MarketingLaunch.tsx — referral-gated Cloudflare / Vercel / template CTAs
src/components/FactoryJsonLd.tsx — HowTo JSON-LD (referral → launch)
src/components/SiteHeader.tsx — factory nav (Referral, Launch, Play)
src/components/SiteFooter.tsx — public footer (hub → megapot.network)
src/lib/referral.ts — 8-char code gate; play destination is /r/{CODE}
src/lib/deploy.ts — Cloudflare + Vercel deeplinks; inject MEGAPOT_PLAY_DESTINATION privately
src/lib/play-redirect.ts — MEGAPOT_PLAY_DESTINATION resolver + hostname UTMs
src/lib/utms.ts — SITE_HOSTNAME → utm_source
src/lib/origin.ts — official Megapot / Network / results origins
src/lib/links.ts — /go, dashboard, results, hub, cloneable, protocol docs
src/lib/site.ts — Build on Megapot | {SITE_NAME}
src/lib/seo.ts — canonical host, IA steps, robots/sitemap policy
src/lib/go-routes.ts — Function-win _routes.json + out/_worker.js + static /go strip
src/styles/cribble.css — cribble tokens (green / ember / ice)
src/styles/factory.css — factory chrome
docs/LAUNCH.md — two-step launch contract (humans + agents)
functions/go.js — Cloudflare Pages Function for /go
functions/go/index.js — trailing-slash /go/
wrangler.toml — Pages project megapot-build; compatibility_date; SITE_HOSTNAME=megapot.build; no account_id
scripts/write-pages-routes.ts — write out/_routes.json + out/_worker.js after next build (tsx; Node 20+)
scripts/check-privacy.mjs — fail on addresses / invite tokens
scripts/check-utms.mjs — hostname UTMs + cribble SoT
scripts/check-go.mjs — Function-win /go shape + live wrangler 302
scripts/check-seo.mjs — title / IA / robots / sitemap / no apex DNS
